children: Following are the results of the Philippine Bureau of the Treasury's (BTr) auction of reissued 2031 T-bonds on Wednesday:
BTr awards 29.56 billion pesos ($472.33 million) of bonds at an average rate of 7.218%, slightly below 30 billion peso offer.
Details on the BTr's website www.treasury.gov.ph.
